# 3D table assets

All five table models are from **Poly Haven** (https://polyhaven.com) and are
released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain). Textures are the 1K glTF variant.

| Local folder | Poly Haven asset | Author |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `round_wooden_table_01` | Round Wooden Table 01 | Ulan Cabanilla |
| `round_wooden_table_02` | Round Wooden Table 02 | Ulan Cabanilla |
| `coffee_table_round_01` | Coffee Table Round 01 | Ulan Cabanilla |
| `chinese_tea_table` | Chinese Tea Table | Kirill Sannikov |
| `painted_wooden_table` | Painted Wooden Table | Kirill Sannikov |

The thumbnails under `thumbs/` are the Poly Haven primary renders of the same
assets, used for the lobby picker.

The classic green-felt table is procedural and part of the game's own art.
